category.leaf: 简约轻商务百搭双肩包

description: 极简轻商务造型，轻量背负、蜂窝透气面料，通勤旅行百搭如第二件衣服

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating seamless light-grey #ECECEC studio sweeps, white #FFFFFF sections, deep charcoal #1E1E1E claim bands, one full-width amber #F5A800 accent band, one misty steel-blue #2C3E5C chapter band reserved for the features chapter, and a grey-blue studio corner (wall meets floor) for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows only, neutral color temperature; flat even graphic lighting on pure infographic bands; raking side light reserved for texture macros
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless studio sweep and matte flat band backgrounds; grey-blue matte studio corner wall-and-floor for flat-lay and scale scenes; no reflective tabletops
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif (CJK-safe) short bold headlines; near-black #1A1A1A on light bands, white on dark bands; short labels and thin divider lines only, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line rounded-square outline icons with uniform #2D2D2D stroke on light backgrounds (white stroke on dark), plus amber #F5A800 square number chips with white numerals
styleLock.presentationRules: product centered and upright, stable front 3/4 hero angle reused across opening and closing shots; callouts always via thin-line icons, amber number chips, or short positional labels; numbered card layouts keep consistent margins and caption placement
noDrift: no brand logos, watermarks or QR codes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal light-business backpack ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light grey #ECECEC studio sweeps, white #FFFFFF sections, deep charcoal #1E1E1E bands, amber #F5A800 accent elements, one misty steel-blue #2C3E5C chapter band, near-black text #1A1A1A on light bands and white text on dark bands; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines only; consistent thin-line rounded-square outline icons with uniform #2D2D2D stroke and amber #F5A800 square number chips; bright soft studio lighting with soft front-left key and soft contact shadows, flat graphic lighting on pure infographic bands; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, centered upright placement with clean breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail-page opening hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} floating upright at a slight 3/4 angle showing full front facade, photographed at eye level, whole silhouette inside the frame. provenance.notes: 18 张 800x1200 切片逐片拼合分析；主产品为图中实际呈现的黑色极简皮质感轻商务双肩包，与源文件夹名「简约双肩包」一致。已剥离：源品牌字样与店铺名、被模糊处理的 logo 织标品牌、参数表中的品牌行、模特面孔（保留角色姿态）、页尾会员二维码贴片。源图中混入两块与手电筒相关的错版痛点文案，与主产品无关，未纳入模版；源参数表面料标注（尼龙/聚酯纤维）互相矛盾，故模版只保留蜂窝织理通用表述，全部参数交由文案槽在投放时填入。
